assertions.name: default-worktree-path-is-used
assertions.evidence: Default Paths section: 'Worktrees are created at: ~/worktrees/<repo>/<branch>'. Example shown.

assertions.name: env-and-dependencies-are-bootstrapped
assertions.evidence: Environment Setup section: auto-handles env files (1Password op inject or copy) and auto-detects + installs dependencies (bun/pnpm/yarn/npm).

assertions.name: source-checkout-stays-untouched
assertions.evidence: Worktrees create a separate path '~/worktrees/<repo>/<branch>' — the main repo checkout is never the worktree target.

assertions.name: one-worktree-per-branch
assertions.evidence: 'git worktree add ~/worktrees/$(basename "$PWD")/feature-name -b feature-name' — each branch gets its own path.

assertions.name: shared-checkout-pattern-is-blocked
assertions.evidence: The skill promotes worktree isolation but does NOT explicitly block or warn against the unsafe same-checkout pattern. The description says 'preventing cross-contamination' but there is no explicit guardrail that rejects or warns when the user proposes multiplexing one checkout.
assertions.gap: Missing: explicit warning or refusal when single-checkout branching is proposed for parallel work.

assertions.name: cleanup-paths-are-reported
assertions.evidence: Quick Commands: 'git worktree remove ~/worktrees/$(basename "$PWD")/feature-name' and 'git worktree prune' are documented.

assertions.name: merged-worktree-is-removed
assertions.evidence: Quick Commands: 'git worktree remove ~/worktrees/<repo>/<branch>' removes the worktree from disk and registry.

assertions.name: stale-refs-are-pruned
assertions.evidence: Quick Commands: 'git worktree prune' is documented alongside the remove command.

assertions.name: active-or-unmerged-worktrees-are-protected
assertions.evidence: The skill documents 'git worktree remove' without any merge-status check or guard. There is no instruction to verify the branch is merged before removal, and no explicit protection for active or in-progress worktrees.
assertions.gap: Missing: pre-removal merge check (e.g. git branch --merged) and explicit warning against removing unmerged worktrees.
